openings.claim: Manifest-ordered, record-cited support ledger may localize earliest supported divergence or unresolved intervals under missingness/reversed timestamps; replaces timestamp ordering and first visible mismatch claims. Separate observed inequalities from explanations; absence never proves nonexecution; definite stage claims cite supplied records.
openings.discriminator: Rival: timestamp-ordered first mismatch. With valid artifact matching, reversal may change rival ordering without changing declared boundaries. Missing transform outputs block unsupported certainty. Removing unique support widens intervals/withdraws certainty; redundant surviving support can retain localization. Track intervals, cited stages, unsupported certainty. Defeat: unsupported earliest certainty, stale citations, lost surviving support, >12 inspections/pair, >60 minutes, or no informative feasible next check; stopping alone is insufficient.
openings.probe: Check manifest/dictionary artifact matching; invalid matching requires unresolved reports. Compare variants on two disjoint three-pair subsets within sixty minutes. Maintain shared comparison ledger per assigned pair; count manual inspections/rereads and reserve final-review capacity within twelve/pair. During final review remove stipulated random transform record from each of two pairs; invalidate removed support. Freeze six reports with stages/intervals, record references, available-resource next checks, counts and time before opening two sealed answer sheets. Use twenty additional minutes to assess covered answers, citation support and uncertainty changes. Next checks name available records or dictionary/manifest checks; state when no informative supplied-resource check remains.
openings.uncertainty: Declared fit uncertain. Manifest order is intended order, not execution/causality evidence; digest matching follows dictionary. One analyst plus supplied spreadsheet/script must sustain setup/review; capacity unmeasured. Blank warnings explain nothing. Two covered answers cannot validate six pairs; disjoint subsets confound comparison. Probe only; feasibility/accuracy unresolved.
